name: sparkles-title

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full composition: logo tile, headline, copy and the glowing arc backdrop.

tagline: A glowing blue horizon with sparkles behind a centred logo and headline.
summary: A hero block with a glowing blue arc at the bottom, a faint grid, tiny rising sparkle particles, a small white logo tile and a centred white headline over a short paragraph.
appearance: On black, a soft blue glow rises from the bottom centre inside a wide dome, with a fine grid of faint lines across the top and small white specks drifting upward. A white rounded-square logo sits above a centred white headline and two small grey lines of copy.
behaviour: The background sparkles drift slowly upward and fade in and out while the blue glow and grid stay still. Hovering or clicking adds particles, but the title and copy never move.
demo_content: The title 'STASH UI' over copy about a curated library of animated, copy-paste React components.
search_phrases: black hero with blue glow arc
grid and glow backdrop for text
use_when: A product's front page needs a calm, atmospheric hero that puts a logo, name and one-sentence pitch front and centre.
avoid_when: The particles run continuously and the block is hardcoded black, so it fights a light theme and never stops.
customise: The headline is a title prop and the paragraph is children; the logo, glow colours, grid, particle density and direction are hardcoded in the markup and sparkle options.
weight_why: A canvas particle engine draws 400 sparkles every frame, forever.

a11y.note: The sparkle canvas has no accessible name or reduced-motion handling, and the logo mark is an empty box with no alt text.

issues: The sparkle motion is barely visible: frames are nearly identical, so it reads as a static hero.
The two-line body copy is tiny and low contrast against black.
polish_why: A distinctive glowing arc composition; the body copy is very small and the motion barely reads.
